units.source_text: 阿民说着说着也流下了眼泪，把儿子广次抱在腿上。

en.t: As Amin went on talking, tears began to fall too, and she held her son Hirotsugu on her lap.

units.source_text: 没料到广次突然有些害羞，只惦记着房间内陈旧榻榻米上的樱花。

en.t: Unexpectedly, Hirotsugu suddenly grew a little shy and could think only of the cherry blossoms on the old tatami mats in the room.
